title: Your LR Schedule May Not Be Principled: Effective Learning Rate Scheduling in Weight-Normalized Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.40362v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Weight-normalized (WN) training is emerging as a compelling alternative to conventional weight decay (WD), with recent studies reporting substantial pretraining loss gains. We find that the effective learning rate (ELR) trajectory accounts for most of the loss dynamics difference between WN and WD. Matching blockwise ELR trajectories step by step closely aligns their loss curves. Schedule design should therefore target ELR rather than the nominal learning rate (LR). Building on this principle, we model directional-alignment dynamics under WN and derive $1/\sqrt{t}$ decay as the optimal schedule. For finite-horizon pretraining, we propose AIR (Affine Inverse-square-Root decay) to match prescribed peak and terminal LRs. translated_title: 你的学习率调度可能并无原则依据：权重归一化训练中的有效学习率调度
translated_abstract: 权重归一化训练正逐渐成为传统权重衰减的一种有吸引力的替代方案，近期研究报道了其在预训练损失上的显著提升。我们发现，有效学习率轨迹解释了权重归一化与权重衰减之间大部分的损失动态差异。逐步匹配分块的有效学习率轨迹可以使两者的损失曲线高度重合。因此，调度设计应当以有效学习率而非名义学习率为目标。基于这一原则，我们对权重归一化下的方向对齐动态进行建模，推导出 1/√t 衰减作为最优调度。针对有限时长的预训练，我们提出了 AIR（仿射反平方根衰减）来匹配给定的峰值和末端学习率。在 128B 和 500B token 的权重归一化混合专家模型预训练实验中，AIR 在损失、下游性能和超参数鲁棒性方面均优于余弦调度及其他备选调度，降低了末端训练损失。
tldr: 本文发现有效学习率轨迹是权重归一化与权重衰减训练损失差异的关键因素，并据此推导出以 1/√t 衰减为基础的 AIR 最优学习率调度，在大规模 MoE 预训练中全面超越余弦等传统调度。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the effective learning rate trajectory, rather than the nominal learning rate, explains the loss dynamics gap between weight-normalized and weight-decay training, and derives AIR (Affine Inverse-square-Root decay based on optimal 1/√t decay), which outperforms cosine and alternative schedules in large-scale MoE pretraining.
